title: Flame Grilling Since 1954 / Restaurant example
slide_intent: Coordinate a heritage claim with identification so a storefront communicates both who it is and what it stands for.
strategic_value: The lit cooking-method statement can reinforce Burger King’s differentiation alongside its familiar burger logo.
demonstration: A dusk restaurant facade places the glowing heritage phrase above the windows and the backed burger logo beside the entrance.
practical_value: Compare the roles of the long roofline claim and compact entrance logo at building scale.

content_islands.name: Roofline claim
content_islands.spec: Place the pale illuminated phrase across the upper facade.

content_islands.name: Entrance logo
content_islands.spec: Keep the orange-and-red backed logo on the dark wall to the right of the doorway.

content_islands.name: Restaurant context
content_islands.spec: Retain the glazing, illuminated food graphics, planting and pavement to show the signage in its setting.

reference_purposes.Expression: The warm lit typography and burger logo contrast with the dark facade and evening sky.
reference_purposes.Application: The heritage lockup and primary logo are shown together on restaurant signage.
